learnings.question: Who is credited with the 1971 observation that ‘what information consumes is rather obvious: it consumes the attention of its recipients’?
learnings.learning: Herbert Simon observed in 1971 that in an information-rich world, the scarce resource that information consumes is attention.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: In one personal AI-driven content-curation system, what single question does the AI ask about each new video before deciding whether to let it through?
options: Would this video get more views than others?
Does this video have high production quality?
Would a Muslim, Malaysian software engineer early in his career actually benefit from watching this?
Is this video trending right now?
learnings.learning: A personal content engine filters daily videos by asking whether a specific target viewer would actually benefit from watching, discarding anything that doesn't pass.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: Which 19th-century psychologist demonstrated that people forget roughly 80% of what they learn within 24 hours unless they actively recall it?
learnings.learning: Hermann Ebbinghaus showed in the 1880s that without active recall, people forget about 80% of newly learned material within a day.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: According to a hadith found in Sahih Muslim, which three things continue to benefit a person even after death?
options: Ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, and a righteous child who prays for them
learnings.learning: A hadith in Sahih Muslim (1631) states that a person's deeds end at death except for ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, and a righteous child who prays for them.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, what is the standard format for writing a user story in the product backlog?
options: As a [role], I need [feature], so that [reason]
learnings.learning: Scrum user stories in the product backlog follow the fixed structure: 'As a [role], I need [feature], so that [reason]'.

learnings.question: What is the main purpose of breaking a project into Sprints in Scrum?
options: To eliminate the need for planning
To increase the length of the project
To allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments
To reduce the number of team members needed
learnings.learning: Scrum breaks work into iterative Sprints specifically to allow teams more flexibility and faster adjustments.

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what term refers to mindfulness or awareness of Allah's presence that builds self-restraint and purifies one's intentions?
learnings.learning: Taqwa is the awareness of Allah's presence that fosters self-restraint and purifies intentions, cultivated through worship.

learnings.question: According to this exploration of life's purpose in Islam, what are the three primary roles that shape a person's life?
options: Worshiping Allah, serving as steward (khalifah) of the Earth, and preparing for the Hereafter through accountability
learnings.learning: Life's purpose in Islam is framed around three roles: worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah (steward) of the Earth, and preparing for the Hereafter through accountable choices.

learnings.question: Which Prophetic saying is cited to explain the continuation of leadership after the death of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)?
options: The believers are like one body
The best of you are those who are best to their families
There will be no prophet after me; instead, there will be caliphs
learnings.learning: A hadith in Sahih Bukhari (3455) states there will be no prophet after Muhammad, but there will be caliphs to continue the role of leadership.

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state represents the device fully operational and actively transmitting data, with no power saving applied?
learnings.learning: L0 is the active PCIe power state in which the device is fully operational and transmitting data with no power saving.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: Which PCIe power state is described as the deepest power-saving state, used for the longest periods of inactivity, with the highest power savings and longest wake-up time?
learnings.learning: L2 is the deepest PCIe sleep state, reserved for the longest idle periods, offering the greatest power savings but the slowest wake-up.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what term refers to the actual unfolding of events in a person's life, as shaped by their actions and decisions?
learnings.learning: Qada' refers to the actual occurrence of events in a person's life, which can be influenced by actions and sincere supplication.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Which Quranic verse (Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:11) is cited to emphasize a person's own responsibility for change in their condition?
options: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.
Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing.
Indeed, Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.
learnings.learning: Surah Ar-Ra'd (13:11) teaches that Allah does not change a people's condition until they change what is within themselves, underscoring personal responsibility.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: When testing whether the Pareto Principle (80/20 rule) applies to the Quran's most frequent words, what did a Python-based word-frequency analysis actually find the top 20 words accumulate to?
learnings.learning: Contrary to the Pareto Principle, a data analysis found the top 20 most frequent words in the Quran accounted for only about 20.83% of the text, not 80%.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: Which verse was found to be the most frequently repeated verse in the Quran, in a word-frequency data analysis using Python?
options: So fear Allah and obey me.
Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
And indeed, your Lord, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to believe.
learnings.learning: A Python-based frequency analysis of Quranic verses found 'Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?' to be the most repeated verse.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python
